login.title: Sign in
login.error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Retry in %.0f s
error.standby: Standby is read-only; use primary (set ENABLE_PANEL=0 on standby)
overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Pending applies, upstream health, and recent rate-limit hits.
overview.none_hint: Summaries appear here after a successful config or firewall apply.
overview.top_empty: No rate-limit hits in the last 5 minutes
overview.top_empty_hint: Nothing to show, or Prometheus is unreachable.
servers.title: Upstream nodes
servers.desc: Shareable upstream library: alias, address, TCP/UDP (empty = off), and enable. Entry type and listen live on Forwards.
servers.add_description: Creates an upstream only — no rules. Add entries under Forwards, or use Add entry on a row.
servers.name: Name
servers.port_enable_hint: Fill a port to enable that protocol; leave empty to skip.
servers.need_ports: Enter at least one TCP or UDP port
servers.confirm_body: Deletes “%s” and its forwards. Irreversible until you restore from Changes.
servers.empty_hint: Add an upstream, or Quick onboard in batch; then configure entries under Forwards.
servers.promote_hint: Enable production forwards for this upstream; creates them if missing
servers.promote_confirm: Enable production forwards for %s? (Validation stays unchanged; missing rules are created.)
servers.quick_description: Batch-write upstreams, optionally with first production entries (validation optional). Then Apply config.
servers.quick_done_body: Upstreams written. Checked entries are created too. Review under Apply config.
servers.quick_need_rows: Add at least one valid upstream row
servers.quick_paste_hint: One per line: alias IP:port, e.g. server-01 185.244.208.205:4301
rules.title: Forwards
rules.desc: Entry type, protocol, listen, and toggles. Upstream address/ports come from Upstreams. Rollback = disable production.
rules.empty_hint: Use Add rule to pick an upstream and entry type, or Add entry from Upstreams.
acl.title: Access lists
acl.desc: Maintain allow/deny source IPs (CIDR) that may reach the listen ports.
acl.add_description: Pick a list and enter a CIDR or IP.
acl.empty_hint: Add a CIDR or IP to this list.
config.title: Config
config.desc: Edit the full YAML in place; save replaces the whole file and overwrites unsaved form edits.
config.edit_warning: Save replaces the whole file and overwrites unsaved form edits.
config.toast_conflict: File changed elsewhere; reloaded — edit again
apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: Push saved config and firewall separately to this host; review the change summary first.
apply.fw_confirm_body: Flushes and loads nftables. Mistakes can break SSH — keep this session and have cloud console ready.
apply.none_hint: After you save config, pending summaries and results show here.
ops.title: Ops
ops.desc: Smoke and canary probes, drain/undrain, firewall syntax check, and ops profile defaults.
ops.drain_hint: Stops new traffic; may wait tens of seconds.
ops.profile_empty_hint: This host has no ops profiles, or they failed to load.
ops.fw_root_hint:
Needs root. Run on the host:
sudo relaygate firewall check
ops.profile_applied_body: Defaults written. Apply config; run firewall apply if nftables changed.
changes.title: Changes
changes.desc: Browse change summaries by timestamp and roll back when needed.
changes.empty_hint: Applies leave timestamped summaries you can review or roll back.
changes.no_summary: (no summary file; stamp can still be rolled back)
monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Open Grafana for metrics; session logs use Loki Explore deep links (no in-panel log store).
monitoring.open_hint: Grafana opens in a separate browser window. Use the sidebar Monitoring item or the button below.
monitoring.disabled: Grafana is not enabled. Set GRAFANA_URL and enable with-grafana, then restart Panel.
servers.add_entry_description: Create missing validation or production entry rules for this upstream.
servers.toast_entry_none: Entry already exists for %s — nothing created
rules.add_description: Pick an existing upstream plus entry type and protocols. Create upstreams on Upstreams or Quick onboard.
rules.need_upstream_hint: Add an upstream on Upstreams (or Quick onboard), then come back to add a rule.
rules.enable_production_missing: No production rules yet — add one first
monitoring.session_logs_hint: Opens Grafana Explore with a prefilled TCP access LogQL query. Client IPs are line filters only — never high-cardinality labels.
monitoring.query_hint: Fill IP / forward rule / time range, then open Explore. Prefer the same gateway label as Prometheus.
